title: Harmonic response about a prestressed equilibrium
source: Closed-form single-degree-of-freedom impedance response, with K, M, damping and substitution in README.md.

quantities.reason: The locked axial coordinate has impedance Z = K − ω²M + iωαM with K = 2,002,000 N/m, M = 2/3 kg, α = 2 N s/m, and unit force at 100 Hz; |U| = 1/|Z|.
For Re(U exp(iωt)), phase = atan2(−ωαM, K − ω²M) from the same scalar impedance.
